title: Jesus and the resurrection
tagline: Did Jesus exist, can we trust the Gospels, and did he rise from the dead?
whyItMatters: Everything in Christianity depends on whether Jesus is who he said he is and whether he rose. Paul says plainly that without the resurrection faith is empty (1 Corinthians 15:14).

mindset.tip: Start from common ground: almost all historians accept that Jesus lived and was crucified.
Read skeptical scholars in their own words, not only summaries by their opponents.
Be honest about what history can and cannot prove; argue for reasonableness, not for a lab result.
Pray as well as argue; the resurrection is meant to be met as well as proved (CCC 640-647).

resources.title: History Shows: Jesus Really Existed
resources.creator: Matt Nelson

resources.title: Are the Gospels Reliable? The Case for Jesus
resources.creator: Dr. Brant Pitre (Catholic Productions)
resources.why: A Catholic Scripture scholar gives a clear first answer to the question.

resources.title: Evidence for the Resurrection of Christ
resources.creator: Peter Kreeft and Ronald K. Tacelli

resources.title: Is Belief in the Resurrection Reasonable?

resources.title: My Book "Did Jesus Exist?" (an answer to the mythicists)
resources.creator: Bart Ehrman
resources.why: A skeptical New Testament scholar explains why he thinks mythicism fails.

resources.title: Did Jesus Rise From the Dead? A Debate with Bart Ehrman
resources.creator: Interesting Times with Ross Douthat (NYT)

resources.note: Ehrman is an agnostic scholar; host is Catholic

resources.title: Lectio: The Case for Jesus (playlist)

resources.title: The Case for Jesus: The Biblical and Historical Evidence for Christ
